snippet.title: ♾️Infinity Nikki Version 1.9 Outfit Preview: Echoed Dreams
snippet.description:
♾️Infinity Nikki Version 1.9 Outfit Preview: Echoed Dreams
The curtains in the box rose layer by layer, and a familiar melody flowed like a stream.
That long-faded dream, that figure enchanted by song,
at last, was reunited with old companions.

♾️ Echoed Dreams
Main Attribute: Sweet
The "Echoed Dreams" outfit grants the [Dance of Verses] ability
After using the ability, Nikki can summon the Melody Carpet. Activate notes to perform graceful dance steps—spin, twirl, and let each step sing.
In Co-op mode, Nikki can use the ability to invite other stylists for a duet performance on the Melody Carpet, creating a harmonious melody together.

Decoration: [Inside the Drapes]
Tagged with both "furniture" and "decoration," [Inside the Drapes] can be placed in open spaces in Miraland or Home for photography or as decoration. Soft light fades gently, harmonies drift. At the rise of the curtain, gaze beyond the drapes. There, a dream of tenderness, peace, and love is always nurtured.
※Available after reaching 160 Resonances in the limited-time Resonance [Finale of Dreams].

——
The Coziest Open-World Game!
Infinity Nikki Version 1.9 "Music Season" launches globally on September 1st (UTC-7)!
#InfinityNikki
